ambiguities_or_notes: Exact audited Russian Markdown source bytes were revalidated against the pinned SHA-256.
All three page markers and every discrete prison-visit, quoted-speech, number, place-name, and closing dialect fragment are represented in source order.
The source is intentionally telegraphic and often lacks recoverable speakers or syntactic links; English preserves that roughness instead of manufacturing narrative continuity.
The otherwise unattested opening Подякатъ is retained as Podyakat rather than conjecturally emended; dialectal заворотень is likewise retained as zavoroten in the one opaque fragment.

жид is rendered with the historical English slur Yid because the immediately following sentence reflects on difference and culpability; the source’s pejorative force is therefore not silently neutralized.
